_: Round 2 (2026-10-04, after the round-1 misses and false positives were read). Cards whose due-ness is a fact of the table (a present person never met, a clue the book hands over here, gear not yet registered, a clock running, a stall counter) move to `state` or `host` triggers: code decides them, Jev is not asked. The `jev` cards keep the one-line `when` for the human index and gain the structured form Jev reads: `what`, `not_for`, `examples` (official criteria fields).

cards.when: The Keeper is about to write a readable carrier: an apply with `document`, a handout, or an item named as paper, letter, note, book, map, photograph; or the player writes in fiction.
cards.host_rule: before an apply whose effects name document/handout, or an item whose definition is readable; and when the player's declaration uses a carried readable item (compile `item` row of a readable definition).

cards.when: A carried thing is drawn, raised, used, shown, handed over, damaged or lost: a camera lifted, a flashlight switched on, a gun drawn, a notebook opened, a helmet hung up.
cards.what: The investigator handles a thing they carry: draws, raises, aims, switches on, opens, hangs up, hands over, uses, breaks or loses it. Taking a photograph, lighting a lamp, writing in a notebook, drawing a weapon all count.
cards.not_for: Money changing hands; a thing only mentioned, worn or kept in a pocket; buying or receiving a new thing from someone else.
examples: 下车端起相机拍了一张
cards.state_rule: only while mods.unregistered_equipment is non-empty; Jev then judges whether a carried thing is handled.

cards.when: The Keeper is about to place a new item, weapon or spell: an apply with `define`, `object` or `item`.
cards.host_rule: before an apply whose effects carry define/object/item; and when the scene's authored material lists things to be handed over here.

cards.when: The Keeper is about to transfer, consume, repair, damage or cast with a registered instance: an apply `object` or a resolve `objects:*` / `magic:*`.
cards.host_rule: before an apply object, resolve objects:use / objects:repair / magic:cast-spell / magic:learn-spell; and when the compile's `item` row names a registered instance.

cards.when: The investigator attacks or uses force with a carried object or a scene object: swings, stabs, shoots, throws, rams, pries, breaks with it.
cards.what: An attack or a forceful use of a thing: a carried weapon or tool, an improvised weapon (a bottle, a chair, a wrench), a scene object, or a vehicle used as force.
cards.not_for: Using a tool in its ordinary way (a flashlight, a camera, a key); threatening without striking; a fight with bare hands.

cards.when: The host refused a narration for an undeclared mechanical object.
Every turn.
An outcome about to land could kill or gravely wound an investigator.
cards.what: The declared action, or what it walks into, could kill or gravely wound the investigator this turn: fighting someone armed or a creature, falling, a trap, a vehicle at speed, fire, drowning.
cards.not_for: Ordinary danger that costs nothing yet: a dark room, a bad feeling, a threat spoken but not acted on.

cards.when: mods.pacing.threat_clocks is non-empty.
director.because.stalled_turns has reached stall_turns, or the Director reads RECOVER.
cards.state_rule: stalled_turns >= settings.stall_turns, or director signal RECOVER

cards.when: The player speaks out of character, is stuck or confused, asks what to do, what their investigator knows, to see a map, or complains about pacing or continuity.
cards.what: The words are the player's, not the investigator's act: a bare prompt ("then what?", "?", "go on"), a question about what the investigator knows or can do, a request to see a map or a recap, a remark on pacing, a complaint that the scene or place is wrong, text in parentheses or marked ooc.
cards.not_for: An investigator's action or line of dialogue, however short; an in-fiction question put to a person present.
examples: 请给我看我目前能知道的农场地图
等等，我刚才明明到了波街公墓，怎么变成教堂公墓了
我已经到了码头，先把眼前发生的事说清楚

cards.when: The Director reads RECOVER.
Every turn.

cards.heading: start
cards.when: A person present has no history with this investigator (natural-npc 1.5.0: the kernel rolls it at first shared scene).
cards.state_rule: present[] has a row whose history/relationships with the investigator are empty

cards.heading: Asking for something
cards.when: The investigator asks a person to grant something at that person's discretion: a favour, a discount, a free thing, work, access, a loan, a secret, a bend of the rules.
cards.what: A request only this person can grant or refuse, that costs them something or bends their rules: do me a favour, give me a better price, let me in, lend me, check my tyre for free, tell me the secret, relay a message to someone above you.
cards.not_for: Buying or ordering at the price asked (a meal, fuel, a room, cigarettes); a question seeking information; a greeting; stating one's business.
examples: 能不能顺手给我查查左后轮、补一下
麻烦你转告负责的警探，我想见他一面

cards.heading: What the asker is after
cards.when: The investigator asks a person present a question or seeks information from them.
cards.what: A question put to a person present, or an attempt to learn something from them: where a place is, what something costs, who someone is, what happened, whether they saw something, what is for sale, how long they have been here.
cards.not_for: A question the player asks the Keeper out of character; a request to be given a thing or a favour; a statement with no question in it.
examples: 镇上哪儿能吃饭、住一晚？
最近有没有一辆蓝色甲壳虫进过镇子？
那边那个大家伙是什么？

cards.heading: The language of the exchange
cards.when: A person present speaks a language the investigator's sheet does not hold at 50 or above, or their `speaks` is unknown.
cards.state_rule: present[].speaks absent, or not covered by the investigator's Language skills

cards.when: known.clues_here lists an undiscovered clue, or mods.thread has a line with `here` or `next`.
cards.state_rule: clues_here has an undiscovered row, or thread lines are present

cards.when: mods.thread.reentry is present.
A clue here is `handed` (plainly in the room, or what a present person says when asked).
cards.state_rule: clues_here has a row whose delivery is handed, or thread `here` names one

cards.when: The player connects evidence, draws a conclusion, asks what the clues mean, or states as fact what a clue only hinted.
cards.what: The player reasons over what they have found: links two clues, names a culprit or cause, asks what it all means, asks a person to confirm a theory, or turns an abbreviated clue into a claim.
cards.not_for: Finding or examining a clue; asking a person a plain factual question; deciding where to go next.
examples: 这么说，大火和那份保险理赔是一回事？
我怀疑这事和我在雅典见过的拜占庭符号有关

cards.when: Every turn.

A price, wage, fare, rent or menu comes up: buying, paying, ordering, filling a tank, renting a room, hiring, being paid or quoted a sum.
cards.what: Money will be named this turn: the investigator buys, orders, pays, fills the tank, rents a room, books a passage, asks what something costs, asks for pay, or is quoted or paid a sum.
cards.not_for: A thing received for nothing; money only mentioned as already spent; a theft.
examples: 要不多给我点？我要多吃点才有力气干活
cards.host_rule: also before an apply whose effects carry cash (quote or settle): the held-out check found 10 of 12 misses were turns where the Keeper itself wrote the money.

cards.when: The player disputes a quoted price as wrong for the period or place.
cards.what: The player objects to a sum the table quoted: says it is too much, not what things cost then, or asks the Keeper to check the price.
cards.not_for: Haggling in character for a better price; asking what something costs; paying.
examples: 1925 年一份汉堡不可能要两块五吧
这房钱太离谱了，你查一下当年的价
